[IARC.3.5.3] **No "peer", "wire", "adapter", "storage", or
"debug" modules.** libds's surface is typed C callbacks
plus structured event payloads, full stop. If two libds
instances or processes need to talk to each other
(cross-tier publish, remote storage, external
debugger), the integrator on each side defines and
implements that protocol. libds emits typed events;
integrators encode bytes if they want bytes.
